seo.title: OnePlastic Initiative | OneGrid Energies
seo.description: OnePlastic transforms waste plastic bottles and discarded batteries into solar-powered lanterns for communities without reliable electricity.

intro.label: OnePlastic Initiative
intro.title: Waste becomes light before the story begins.
intro.subtitle: Background Video 2 introduces the OnePlastic journey before you continue into the initiative, its model, and its community impact.

hero.title: We transform *plastic waste* and discarded laptop batteries into solar-powered lanterns that reduce darkness in underserved communities.

overview.title: Waste becomes light, opportunity, and hope.
overview.text: Our flagship initiative, OnePlastic, transforms discarded plastic bottles and e-waste lithium-ion batteries from old laptops into affordable solar lanterns designed for low-income and rural households. Instead of allowing these materials to pollute the environment, we convert them into tools for education, safety, and opportunity.

community.title: Power that creates local opportunity.
community.text: The lanterns are charged through community-based IoT-enabled solar charging stations strategically installed in underserved communities and managed primarily by rural women. This approach creates local ownership while also generating income opportunities for women who operate the stations.

business_model.title: Access first. Sustainable revenue always.
business_model.text: Our business revenue model combines product sales with subscription-based services. This hybrid approach allows us to offer our lanterns at a subsidized rate or no cost and generate recurring income through charging fees.

points.text: Lanterns are designed for exclusive charging at our stations.
Additional revenue streams come from charging mobile phones and other devices.
Cloud-based platforms monitor performance, payments, and usage.

scalability.title: Built to grow where the need is greatest.

paragraphs.text: OneGrid Energies' business model is highly scalable. By leveraging strategic partnerships and collaborations, we can quickly expand our reach to new markets and regions. Our smart solar charging stations and rechargeable lanterns can be easily replicated and distributed to meet growing demand.
paragraphs.heading: Scalability:

paragraphs.text: Our business model is replicable in various regions, particularly in off-grid communities with limited access to electricity. By using locally sourced materials and partnering with local organizations, we can adapt our model to suit different markets and environments.
paragraphs.heading: Replicability:

paragraphs.text: By utilizing waste plastic bottles and repurposing lithium-ion batteries, we minimize production costs. Our smart solar charging stations and rechargeable lanterns are designed for efficiency and durability, reducing maintenance and replacement costs.
